retention_policy: Metadata and concise paraphrases only; no paper, raw HTML, XML feed, or raw API payload retained.

records.title: Klassenzahlen definiter quadratischer Formen
records.inspected: Publisher metadata and bibliographic record.
records.supports: Primary provenance for the neighboring method used to traverse classes of definite quadratic forms.
records.does_not_support: Does not identify the five 2-neighbors from K12 orthogonal_sum E8, the root-count sequence, T20, either frozen signature, or novelty.

records.title: Kneser's Method of Neighbors
records.inspected: Title, bibliographic metadata, definitions, and scope statements.
records.supports: Modern account of p-neighbor definitions, construction, and stated connectivity results.
records.does_not_support: Does not state or classify Signature B's five-step route and does not support Signature A.

records.title: Constructing integral lattices with prescribed minimum. II
records.inspected: Crossref metadata, catalogue citations, and available abstract-level description.
records.supports: Nearby primary prior art on constructing integral laminated lattices of prescribed minimum four, including rank-20 catalogue entries.
records.does_not_support: Its rank-20 catalogue descendants KAPPA20 and LAMBDA20 have determinants and kissing numbers different from T20; no exact Gram, five-neighbor route, or Signature A was found.

records.title: Classification of integral lattices with large class number
records.inspected: Crossref metadata and bibliographic references.
records.supports: Conceptual classification context for integral-lattice genera and class enumeration.
records.does_not_support: No theorem, table, or metadata match to either frozen signature was found; it is not a complete classification of the relevant determinant-729 rank-20 genus.

records.title: A Catalogue of Lattices
records.inspected: Index, dimension-20 and dimension-24 listings, search result for 5076, catalogue size statement, and warning.
records.supports: A broad author-maintained index reporting about 160,000 lattice entries and linking standard rank-20, K12, E8, and Leech records.
records.does_not_support: The catalogue explicitly warns that not all entries have been checked and is not exhaustive novelty evidence; no 5076 index hit was found.

records.title: The Lattice KAPPA20
records.inspected: Dimension, determinant, minimum, kissing number, Gram metadata, and references.
records.supports: A nearby rank-20 minimum-four integral lattice from the Plesken-Pohst construction literature.
records.does_not_support: KAPPA20 has determinant 81 and kissing number 15390, not determinant 729 and 5076; it is not T20.

records.title: The Lattice LAMBDA20
records.inspected: Dimension, determinant, minimum, kissing number, Gram metadata, and references.
records.supports: A standard rank-20 minimum-four laminated lattice useful as a numeric near-match control.
records.does_not_support: LAMBDA20 has determinant 64 and kissing number 17400, not determinant 729 and 5076; it is not T20.

records.title: The Lattice K12 (The Coxeter-Todd Lattice)
records.inspected: Rank, determinant, minimum, kissing number, integrality, 3-modularity, and displayed matrices.
records.supports: Standard metadata for the rank-12 determinant-729 minimum-four 3-modular starting block K12.
records.does_not_support: Does not give the K12 orthogonal_sum E8 neighbor route, T20, the final 5076 shell, or Signature A.

records.title: The Lattice E8
records.inspected: Rank, determinant, minimum, root count, and displayed matrices.
records.supports: Standard metadata for the rank-8 determinant-one E8 starting block.
records.does_not_support: Does not give the five-neighbor route, T20, or Signature A.

records.title: The Leech Lattice LAMBDA24
records.inspected: Catalogue index and linked standard Leech-lattice metadata.
records.supports: Standard rank-24 rootless even-unimodular complement used in the bare direct sum.
records.does_not_support: Does not identify T20, supply the 44-dimensional endpoint frame package, or prove Signature A.

records.title: On theta series attached to maximal lattices and their adjoints
records.venue: Journal of the Ramanujan Mathematical Society 25, 265-284
records.inspected: Abstract and theorem/table-level statements, including the rank-20 3-elementary discussion.
records.supports: Nearby primary prior art on theta series of maximal even exact-level-N determinant-N^2 lattices and dual-extremal 3-elementary examples.
records.does_not_support: For N=3 its exact setting has determinant 9, not 729. Its unique rank-20 dual-extremal 3-elementary statement is in a different genus, and the displayed full-genus class number is not computed; it does not identify T20 or Signature A.

records.title: Frames over finite fields: Equiangular lines in orthogonal geometry
records.inspected: Abstract and Example 5.5 metadata/theorem context.
records.supports: Related primary prior art connecting strongly regular graphs and equiangular tight frames over finite fields; a hypothetical Conway graph yields a (2,1,4)-ETF of 100 vectors in F5^45.
records.does_not_support: The finite-field 100-by-45 ETF is categorically and numerically different from Signature A's real integral 231-row rank-44 endpoint, and it does not state either frozen signature.

records.title: Spherical Codes and Designs
records.inspected: Bibliographic metadata and theorem scope.
records.supports: Foundational spherical-code and design terminology relevant to alternate searches for shells and Euclidean representations.
records.does_not_support: Does not contain the exact decomposable h=729 classification, T20, or the numerical fingerprints.

records.title: Finite Normalized Tight Frames
records.inspected: Bibliographic metadata and theorem scope.
records.supports: Standard finite normalized tight-frame theory and terminology.
records.does_not_support: Does not supply the 105/126 row split, traces 36/24, determinant allocation, fourteen exclusions, or T20.

records.title: On the automorphism group of a putative Conway 99-graph
records.inspected: Publisher abstract, article metadata, and scope.
records.supports: A current refereed primary source explicitly describing existence of the Conway 99-graph as an elusive open problem and proving conditional automorphism restrictions.
records.does_not_support: Does not construct or exclude the graph and does not state either frozen signature.

records.title: Approaching the Conway-99 problem using SAT solvers
records.inspected: Current arXiv metadata, version history, and abstract/full-text status language.
records.supports: A current primary computational attempt reporting that the finite search remains too demanding for the attempted SAT approaches.
records.does_not_support: Does not resolve Conway-99 and does not contain either frozen signature.

records.title: Minimum 2-Percolating Sets in 2-Connected, Diameter 2 Graphs
records.inspected: Relevant theorem and status discussion concerning the putative (99,14,1,2) graph.

records.does_not_support: Does not construct or exclude the graph and does not state either frozen signature.

records.venue: e-Journal of Analysis and Applied Mathematics 2024, 1-14

records.does_not_support: Does not construct or exclude the target graph and does not state either frozen signature.

records.title: Non-existence of the Strongly Regular Graph srg(85,14,3,2)
records.venue: Institutional seminar notice for a lecture by Sergey Shpectorov
records.inspected: Institutional notice and described lecture scope.
records.supports: Corroborates that a June 2026 seminar proposed only a possible analogous approach to Conway-99 after a different nonexistence result.
records.does_not_support: Not a primary theorem source for Conway-99 and does not announce a result for (99,14,1,2).
